description: Prose budgets for a rule document, in words. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/code.md, which states the rule — keep a rule document focused and concise — without fixing a number; the caps here are that rule made decidable, set from the corpus as it stands. Prose words only: fenced code blocks and table rows are free, so an example costs nothing and the marker clause above it costs one line. Every rule section falls under `default`; Rule and Checklist have their own caps because each restates the whole document once — Rule before the examples, the Checklist after them; the reference sections are navigation and are not capped.
